This is a data set that contains forty-one (41) scans of the Ogilvie Grain Elevator, Wrentham. All data was collected by the Capture2Preserv team between the 22nd and 23rd of August 2022. The Z+F 501X and the GeoSLAM ZEB Horizon laser scanners were both used to collected data of the elevator.  The Z+F 5010X scanner was sued to collect sixteen (16) interior scans and twenty-three (23) exterior scans, which were registered in Z+F Laser Control and further processed in Autodesk ReCap Pro. Two GeoSLAM ZEB Horizon scans were created, which were registered and processed in GeoSlam Connect.
